codec.source: RESEARCH_LOG INF-13 (High Profile, 2 consecutive B frames, closed GOP, GOP of half the frame rate, CABAC, 4:2:0) and INF-12 (variable bitrate)

targets.source: RESEARCH_LOG INF-12 (SDR 1080p, standard frame rate 24, 25, 30: 8 Mbps)

vbv.status: PROPOSAL, REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): 1.5x / 2x the target; measured 2026-11-19 on 1080p30 random noise (8 s, preset faster): one-pass ABR alone ran 33.6 / 2.1 / 5.1 / 6.6 Mbps per 2 s window (mean 11.87), with this cap 9.3 / 8.5 / 8.2 / 8.1 (mean 8.52); still graphics 0.15 Mbps and testsrc2 8.15 Mbps unchanged; ADR-014 section 3.4

targets.source: RESEARCH_LOG INF-12 (SDR 1080p, high frame rate 48, 50, 60: 12 Mbps)

vbv.status: PROPOSAL, REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): 1.5x / 2x the target; measured 2026-11-19 on 1080p60 random noise (6 s, preset faster): ABR alone 26.5 / 9.8 / 10.7 Mbps per 2 s window (mean 15.67), with this cap 13.8 / 12.2 / 12.1 (mean 12.72); ADR-014 section 3.4

requires_review: 2560x1440, 3840x2160 and every other size: owner decision D10 covers 1080p only (INF-12 lists other sizes; not adopted)
1080x1920 (9:16): INF-12 does not say whether the 1080p row applies to vertical video
fractional frame rates (for example 30000/1001): INF-12 lists 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60 only
